candidate.answerReason: In sixtieths, Beth, Cyril, Dan, and Alex consumed 20, 15, 13, and 12, respectively.

methods.label: Express every share in sixtieths
methods.explanation:
Using a common denominator makes both the leftover calculation and the comparison straightforward. Alex ate \(12/60\), Beth ate \(20/60\), and Cyril ate \(15/60\). Dan's share was
\[
1-\frac15-\frac13-\frac14
=\frac{60-12-20-15}{60}
=\frac{13}{60}.
\]
All four shares now have the same denominator. Since \(20>15>13>12\), the decreasing order is \(\boxed{\text{Beth, Cyril, Dan, Alex}}\), choice C.
methods.levelReason: The method uses elementary fraction subtraction, common denominators, and comparison of equal-denominator fractions.
